question: Select the most appropriate option the fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dare**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The passage describes Mr. Cyril Boggis' talent in buying and selling antique furniture at a profit. The word in blank 4 refers to how he sells the items.
 
• The word "dear" (महंगा) appropriately fits the context of selling items at a high price. It directly contrasts with "cheap" and implies charging a lot for the items after purchasing them inexpensively.
 
• Other options like "door" (दरवाज़ा), "dare" (हिम्मत करो), and "deer" (हिरण) do not fit the context of selling items at a high price or profit.

Correct Answer: Option 3

 

**Complete Passage: **"Apart from the fact that he was at this moment, disguised as a spiritual leader in the Christian Church, there was nothing sinister about Mr. Cyril Boggis. He was by trade a dealer in antique furniture, with his own shop and showroom in the King’s Road, Chelsea. His premises were not large, and generally he did not do a great deal of business, but because he always bought very, very cheap and sold very, very dear, he managed to make quite a tidy little income every year."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
• "Door" (दरवाज़ा) refers to an entrance and is unrelated to the context of selling goods at a high price.
 
• "Dare" (हिम्मत करो) refers to having the courage or boldness to do something, which does not fit the context of pricing or the act of selling items at a high value.
 
• "Deer" (हिरण) refers to an animal, which does not make sense in the context of antique furniture sales.

Thus, the correct word to fill in blank number 4 is "dear" (Option 3).
